title: Add goal evaluator contract tests
objective: Define a transcript-only GoalEvaluator contract before loop integration.
context: Claude Code's documented implementation uses a small fast model after each turn.
The evaluator must not run tools or read files; it only receives the goal condition and transcript evidence.

source_evidence.note: Evaluator sees transcript only and returns yes/no with a short reason.
Existing provider abstraction should be reused or wrapped.

include: Test met and unmet evaluator results.
Test evaluator reason is stored and suitable for continuation guidance.
Test evaluator receives transcript snapshots without tool execution capability.
Test evaluator errors fail closed with a visible warning or non-continuation.

implementation_steps: Define a fake evaluator interface in tests if production type is absent.
Assert input contains condition and messages but no registry or tool handles.
Assert usage fields can be reported separately.
deliverables: Failing tests that define GoalEvaluator behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Tests do not call external models.
Tests produce a small implementation target.
risks: A provider-backed evaluator could accidentally be allowed to call tools later.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing tests for a transcript-only GoalEvaluator: met/unmet/error results, short reason, optional usage, and no tool/file access. Do not implement production code.
notes_for_assignee: The evaluator should be easy to fake for loop tests.
